scene: Inside the ornate dragon gondola, transit route portals glow before you.
picture: Flat side view along red-lacquered boat decking. Far left sits a brass solar console. Left, the broad Pacific Islander holds skewers and ukulele beside velvet seats. Centre stands a glowing maglev turnstile gate. Right, silk lanterns hang overhead, and far right awaits an open pink bullet train hatch.
shown: a golden junk ticket slot on a brass console, far left
a glowing maglev turnstile gate humming with green neon, centre
a sleek pink transit hatch waiting open, far right
